sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt:
USE OF PROCEEDS The exchange offer is intended to satisfy our obligations under the registration rights agreement that we entered into with the initial
purchasers of the Old Notes. We will not receive any cash proceeds from the exchange offer. In consideration for issuing the New Notes as contemplated by this prospectus, we will receive a like principal amount in exchange of the Old Notes. Old
Notes that are surrendered in exchange for New Notes will be retired and cancelled and will not be reissued. Accordingly, the issuance of the New Notes under the exchange offer will not result in any increase in our outstanding indebtedness. Subject
